traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Krameriaceae: leaves alternate; leaves usually simple, rarely compound; margins entire; stipules absent; plants hermaphrodite; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody or herbaceous; flowers solitary or in racemes; flowers zygomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit achene; stamens (3-) 4; carpels 2. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
